evals.name: smug-told-you-so
evals.prompt: I called this exact bug last week and the team ignored me. now it's blowing up in prod. find me a sticker that captures the smug 'I told you so' energy — I want to send it in slack.
evals.expected_output: Top candidate memes downloaded into /tmp/yiyang-find-bqb/<some-label>/ with Chinese filenames matching smug/told-you-so vibes (得意, 假笑, 早就说了, 滑稽). The model presents the paths to the user without picking one for them.

assertions.text: Output directory is under /tmp/yiyang-find-bqb/
At least 3 candidate image files exist in the output directory
Every downloaded image file is non-empty (>0 bytes)
At least one downloaded filename contains CJK Chinese characters
Keywords used contain CJK Chinese characters (not English-only)
Final response includes at least one /tmp/yiyang-find-bqb/... file path
Final response presents multiple candidates without picking one for the user
